messages:
ravi: Hey team — PR #4212 CI is red. Only matrix shard 3/6 failed with `tests.integration.api::TestUserFlows::test_oauth_timeout`. Looks flaky. Can someone retrigger just that shard and keep the docker cache? I don't want a full image rebuild.

jen: Use the internal rerun tool: `ci retry --job=pr-4212:matrix:shard-3 --no-image` — that should requeue just the shard and skip rebuilding images.

kevin: If you prefer GH CLI, this requeues the specific job:
```
gh run rerun 1234567890 --job pr-4212/matrix/shard-3
```
Replace 1234567890 with the run id (you can get it from the Actions UI or ci-bot).

marcus: FYI if we need artifacts or wheels preserved, add `--preserve-cache` to the ci tool:
```
ci retry --job=pr-4212:matrix:shard-3 --no-image --preserve-cache
```
That keeps cached layers/artifacts and avoids a clean rebuild.

ravi: run id is 1234567890 — trying `gh run rerun` now, thanks.

ci-bot: Requeued job pr-4212/matrix/shard-3 (run 1234567890) — attempt 1. Check progress: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/1234567890

jen: If it flakes repeatedly, we can bisect the PR range for that test: `ci bisect --pr 4212 --test tests.integration.api::TestUserFlows::test_oauth_timeout --parallel 3` — narrows down offending commit.

ravi: Re-run turned green. Thanks all :thumbsup: — closing the loop.

kevin: quick note for next time: prefer `--no-image --preserve-cache` combo for shard-only retries that depend on built wheels. Saves ~6-8m.

marcus: adding to our runbook entry: "targeted-shard-retry" with examples above.

ravi: great, cheers.
